name_story.story: Sultana can be understood through the Arabic form سُلْطَانَة, whose central sense is sultana; ruler, queen. Sultana is Arabic سُلْطَانَة (Sulṭāna), the feminine of سُلْطَان, meaning 'ruler, queen'.

faq.a: Sultana is associated with the Arabic form سُلْطَانَة, whose core sense is sultana; ruler, queen.

faq.q: What is the origin of Sultana?
faq.a: Sultana is associated with Arabic. Sultana is Arabic سُلْطَانَة (Sulṭāna), the feminine of سُلْطَان, meaning 'ruler, queen'.
Yes — the underlying form سُلْطَانَة is Arabic.
Sultana can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Sultana should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root س ل ط is Quranic (authority), but Sulṭāna is not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Sultana mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Sultana is rendered سلطانہ and carries the sense سلطانہ، ملکہ.

faq.q: What does Sultana mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Sultana is rendered سلطانه and carries the sense سلطانه، فرمانروا.
A romanized syllable approximation is sul-ta-na. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Sultana?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Sultana, sultana. Script forms are سلطانه, سلطانہ, سُلْطَانَة, सुल्ताना.

faq.q: Is Sultana a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
